role: Freelance Consultant, IT Solutions & Business Operations
summary: Independent MIS and operations support for small and medium businesses.
bullets: Advise SMEs on IT solutions and MIS, covering requirement analysis, workflow optimisation and data reporting.
Write technical documentation and project plans that a client team can run after handover.
Support business development with technical proposals and solution design.

org: Huawei Technologies Nepal Co., Pvt. Ltd.
summary: Six years across technical solutions, project control and delivery coordination in a multinational operating environment.

groups.title: Technical solution and strategy
bullets: Translated client business and technical requirements into scalable IT solutions, from design and integration through implementation.

Ran technical feasibility studies, risk assessments and system-security evaluations.
Led solution design and forecasting against business trends and customer requirements.
Worked with sales, finance, supply chain and delivery teams to prepare technical bids and finalise solutions.

groups.title: Project control and operations
bullets: Delivered 100 Ncell swap sites in a single day in Kathmandu (2015).
Planned, executed and monitored projects to hold delivery dates and quality standards.

Oversaw budgeting, contracting and administration for project management.
Kept ERP data accurate and issued regular performance reports to senior management.
Led material planning and inventory coordination from BOQ and SCM systems.
Introduced change-control processes to keep execution on course.

groups.title: Leadership and coordination
bullets: Guided vendors and internal teams to build capability and meet delivery timelines.
Aligned project outcomes with customer expectations through regular stakeholder coordination.
Supervised support staff and kept records and documentation orderly.

awards: Employee of the Month, awarded several times.

Certificate of Merit, Top Performing Team, WDM Golden Seeds Training Programme, Shenzhen, China (2019).

summary: Site surveys of telecom base stations.
